answer:
APPROVE.

This is a bounded, reversible same-binary A/B check within the authorized RTX 5090 migration. It appropriately avoids inferring provider policy or a general 5090 limitation from one node.

Conditions:
- Provision exactly one additional diagnostic pod; prefer a different host and record host, driver, GPU, and relevant library versions.
- Run only the persisted compiled NVENC 13 probe before any restore, rebuild, custom bootstrap, credential injection, or application start.
- Prevent shared-volume write races: mount read-only where feasible and write results node-locally, or use a node-specific evidence path.
- If the probe fails, retain results, stop further provisioning/migration work, and leave the first node intact and the old pod stopped.
- If it succeeds, run the 60-frame encode verification before any asset migration; subsequently hash-verify transferred assets and preserve the first baseline.

This approval covers only the diagnostic node check and stated contingency path, not migration acceptance.
